findings.reason: The calculation does not define how the operator identifies or verifies that an engagement is by or attributable to senior Sofia talent, so qualifying observations require guessing.
findings.quote: Each LinkedIn or Substack engagement action during the monthly Month 6-Month 12 reporting window on approved Signed by Humans senior craft story content by, or attributable to, the senior Sofia talent audience; qualifying actions include platform-recorded reactions, comments, shares, saves where available, newsletter clicks, replies or other recorded engagement actions tied to the craft story asset.

findings.reason: The metric promises engagement quality, but the calculation only counts relevant non-spam engagement actions without a quality scale, anchors or score meaning.
findings.quote: Each relevant, non-spam engagement action on a Month 11 advocate post recorded in LinkedIn analytics or inbound-response records, including reactions, substantive comments, reposts or shares, saves where available, proof-page click-throughs, and qualified inbound responses tied to the post.
